# Hindricks et al.

Hindricks et al. is the citation shorthand for the authors of the European Society of Cardiology's (ESC) guidelines on the management of atrial fibrillation, which serve as a key evidentiary basis for the patient education recommendations documented in the AFDK (Atrieflimren i Danmark) quality program [^src1]. The guidelines were developed in 2020 and published under the Hindricks et al. citation in 2021 [^src1]. In the AFDK material, the reference appears twice, both times in connection with the same guideline document — once simply as "Hindricks et al., 2021" and once framed as "ESC guidelines fra 2020 (Hindricks et al., 2021)" [^src1].

This citation sits within a chapter of the AFDK 2024 report documenting Indicator 8, Structured Patient Education, which is administered by Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram. That chapter lays out the evidence base for structured patient education as an integral part of atrial fibrillation treatment, drawing on both the ESC guidelines and Danish national recommendations, and describes the purpose, methods, content, and implementation of such education, including the ABC Pathway model for integrated atrial fibrillation care — covering stroke prevention (A), better symptom control (B), and cardiovascular risk reduction (C) — as well as a geographic overview of the Danish health clusters participating in the AFDK program [^src1]. Hindricks et al.'s guidelines are cited as the underlying scientific authority supporting the case for structured patient education within this broader framework [^src1].

No relationships or additional claims about Hindricks et al. beyond the guideline authorship and publication timeline are present in the source material.
